question: Who is the cabinet minister of the Union Ministry of Heavy Industries as of September 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**HD Kumaraswamy**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **HD Kumaraswamy** is the cabinet minister for the **Union Ministry of Heavy Industries** as of **September 2024**.
 
• He has been a prominent leader in the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** and is known for his contributions to infrastructure development, especially in the **transportation sector**.
 
• The **Ministry of Heavy Industries** oversees the development and promotion of heavy industries such as machine tools, heavy electricals, and automotive manufacturing.
 
• Nitin Gadkari has played a significant role in advancing the government's focus on electric vehicles
